items.title: Kitchen cabinet handle placement
items.status: Passed desktop visual and measured geometry checks
items.response: The shared cabinet generator had incorrectly placed every door handle near the top. Overhead pulls now centre at 1750 mm instead of 2250 mm, pantry pulls at 1100 mm, and paired door pulls meet at the centre edges. Base and drawer handle heights are retained. Short mounting posts attach the bars to the door fronts. Laundry overheads shared the same defect and are corrected too. These hardware offsets are illustrative, not dimensions given on sheet 16.

items.title: Independent fittings and timber stair visibility
items.status: Passed desktop visual and control checks
items.response: Six independent groups with colliders following visibility, room-change persistence and restart restoration. Walls/roof controls remain independent. Stair risers/stringers switch from their painted finish to timber, while rails, brackets and underside linings hide with the walls. The same geometry is retained, without overlapping variants. Eight offline lighting states keep the empty room free from hidden-fitting shadows. Mixed selections use an empty-room shell and the surviving fittings’ original baked shading; fine inter-object shading is approximate. Static reflection captures switch too; there are no runtime reflection cameras or extra lights.
